name: ambe49_causal_v1
input: AMBE+2 2450 bps frames (AMBE-3000R rate 34 / ambe_d order), 49 bits per 20 ms, + erasure mask

corpora: LibriSpeech train-clean-100 / train-clean-360 / train-other-500 (CC BY 4.0), 960 h
training.augmentation: bit errors 0-3 % (p 0.4), frame erasures in 1-3 frame bursts (p 0.3)
training.vocoder: causal clean-speech vocoder trained with neurodec (model.causal, no look-ahead) on VCTK / JVS / JSUT, frozen

latency.note: frame t uses the bits of frames <= t + lookahead; the output is final 20 ms x lookahead + 32 ms after frame t (on top of the reference decoder's timing)

evaluation.set: LibriSpeech test-clean 40 speakers x 5 + JSUT basic5000 last 50 (250 utterances), reference = clean input at 8 kHz
evaluation.abx_vs_26M_model: 40 Japanese trials (clean / bit errors / erasures mixed), 25/40 correct, one-sided binomial p = 0.077: not distinguishable at 5 %
